svg.aria-label: The heart of the attention code, with a handwritten comment beside each line: query, key and value make each working card's query, key and value cards; q at k transpose matches every query with every key; dividing by the square root of 32 shrinks the scores; masked_fill means only listen to earlier positions; softmax shares out attention so every row adds up to 100 percent; attn at v collects the value cards in those shares.
svg.text: Attention, in eight lines of code
From the notebook's CausalSelfAttention.forward, with the lines that split and rejoin the heads left out
